agents.description: Produces short presenter-led videos end to end: one idea, a script written for the ear, correct framing per destination, and a localized cut.
agents.name: Presenter Video Producer

description: One producer for short presenter-led video, covering conversational discovery, scripts written for the ear, the exact-text list, aspect ratio and caption safe areas per destination, and a reviewed localization pass. Adapted from an MIT-licensed upstream collection of video skills, with the vendor product, API and command-line plumbing left behind and only the production craft kept.
name: Presenter Video Studio

skills.name: Spoken Script Writing

skills.name: Video Localization

skills.name: Aspect and Framing Check
